title: Report: Lions blocked Dolphins' request to interview Bruce Gradkowski

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Report: Lions blocked Dolphins' request to interview Bruce Gradkowski
sources.description: The Dolphins hired Nathaniel Hackett as their quarterbacks coach, but they had interest in interviewing Bruce Gradkowski for the job before adding Hackett to Jeff Hafley's staff.
